commit.description: Commit the executable was built from ("dev" when running from source).

builtAt.description: Build timestamp of the executable ("dev" when running from source).

VersionResponse.description: Build and contract version information for the running server.

defaultWorkingDirectory.description: Canonical (symlink-resolved) absolute path new Threads and Terminals default to.

Project.description: A Project: the user-facing container organizing a body of work.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: Partial update; affects future Threads and Terminals only.

TerminalStatus.description: Public terminal lifecycle state: live (zmx session running) or ended (tombstone until deleted).

threadId.description: Owning thread id when this terminal is a Thread's TUI terminal; absent otherwise.

command.description: Immutable exec-style argv the terminal was launched with; absent for an interactive login shell.

initialWorkingDirectory.description: Canonical directory the terminal was launched in (immutable).

endedAt.description: When the terminal was observed ended (ISO 8601 UTC); absent while live.

Terminal.description: A durable, project-scoped terminal backed by a zmx session.

command.description: Exec-style argv to run instead of an interactive login shell.

workingDirectory.description: Directory to launch in; defaults to the project's default working directory. Stored canonicalized.

CreateTerminalRequest.description: Payload for creating a terminal. Creation starts the zmx session immediately.

UpdateTerminalRequest.description: Partial update; only the display label is mutable.

ThreadActivityState.description: Normalized activity of the thread's agent session, derived from live provider evidence only; `unknown` means no evidence — never a guess.

workingDirectory.description: Canonical directory the thread's agent session works in (immutable).

linkedTerminalId.description: The thread's live TUI terminal, when one is open (derived; never required).

archivedAt.description: When the thread was archived (ISO 8601 UTC); absent while active.

Thread.description: A durable Thread: the primary unit of agent work. Its ATC identity is separate from provider identity, and it never requires a Terminal.

workingDirectory.description: Directory the agent session will work in; defaults to the project's default working directory. Stored canonicalized; immutable afterwards.

CreateThreadRequest.description: Payload for creating a thread. Creation is local-only: the durable record is written and no provider session is created until the first interaction.

UpdateThreadRequest.description: Partial update; only the display label is mutable.

available.description: Whether the agent's CLI is installed and resolvable right now.

reason.description: Actionable install-or-configure hint; absent when available.

detectedVersion.description: Installed CLI version, when it could be determined.

testedVersion.description: Version the adapter was validated against (drift warns, never blocks).

tuiObservation.description: How live activity is observed while a TUI drives a session: full event fan-out from the shared provider server, or coarser provider hook callbacks.

Agent.description: A built-in agent provider: availability and capability report, detected on demand and never persisted.

DirectoryState.description: Tagged result of a demand-driven directory health check.

path.description: The checked path (canonicalized when the directory is available).

reason.description: Why the state is not conclusive (e.g. "timeout" for unknown); absent otherwise.

FsCheckResponse.description: Result of a directory health check. Never persisted.
